'''2001 Normal DPC warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG warm-up held at Cyberia (Gamer's Haven), Normal, Illinois on 23 February 2001. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1790">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-geoffs-dpc-warmupd1790/ geoffs-dpc-warmup], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-geoffs-dpc-warmupd1790/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Normal DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 23 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Cyberia (Gamer's Haven), Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 30
